# Bundled managed libraries

ZstdSharp.Port 0.8.6 (MIT), Oleg Stepanischev, commit
`f475a7d4746d305094fbb09563cb0fcb167bec18`, netstandard2.1 binary.
Source: https://github.com/oleg-st/ZstdSharp

System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe 6.0.0 (MIT), .NET Foundation,
netstandard2.0 binary. Source: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime

License texts are included alongside the binaries. These are managed Editor
dependencies, not platform-specific compressors or external applications.
Unity includes the standard .NET API surface; no NuGet setup is needed by users.
